facts.value: This course is excellent at giving you a good insight into all the different areas of psychology, including working in mental health, examining social issues like racism, conducting research and so much more!

In first year, you have some freedom to choose the subjects you study. Everybody has to do three core psychology modules, but aside from that you can choose from a range of subjects like biology, sociology, language and culture.
The co-op and Erasmus semesters were a huge selling point for students.
Studied for six months at the University of Copenhagen in Denmark on an Erasmus placement.
Made loads of friends from all over the world during the Erasmus placement.
Chose a module on Danish Culture, which involved weekly trips to castles and museums and even the cinema.
Completed Co-op placement at the University of Westminster in London as a research assistant on a number of different projects.
Learned how everything studied at UL actually applied to the real world through the Co-op experience.
Currently studying for a Masters in Applied Psychology (Mental Health and Psychological Therapies) at the University of Ulster.
